root_axis: Y-up, fortress front and escape chute toward +Z
detail_firewall: No ornamental props, particles, texture polish or animation work before the hero wedge and complete naked macro assembly each pass 0.85 in every required view.

review_units.reason: The sea, cliff silhouette and falling lava form one continuous depth cue.
The keep and fortified maze must read as one monumental city rather than disconnected blocks.
The traversable route, maze choices and hazardous channels must remain visually separable at phone scale.
The four landmarks need distinct silhouettes but a shared fortress language.
The mission reads only when launch, descent and extraction form one clear spatial chain.

parts.owns: continuous irregular magma surface below the island
parts.acceptance: deep moving molten field with cooled crust plates; never a flat checker

parts.owns: continuous volcanic island mass and deep underside
parts.acceptance: three or more irregular vertical basalt strata with no horizontal belt seam

parts.owns: front gorge, lavafall lip, contact basin and cliff glow
parts.acceptance: source-dominant lavafall visibly exits the city and strikes the sea below

parts.owns: monumental central tower, buttresses and crown
parts.acceptance: tallest form by a clear margin; occupies the visual center and remains recognizable in silhouette

parts.owns: north-south axial forge halls and molten core aperture
parts.acceptance: creates an architectural axis from rear gate through keep to front lavafall

parts.owns: continuous crenellated perimeter and corner bastions
parts.acceptance: fortress perimeter is continuous, layered and clearly taller than interior maze walls

parts.owns: four independently readable multi-level labyrinth quadrants
parts.acceptance: each quadrant contains one broad route, one risky shortcut and vertical bridges; never uniform wall noise

parts.owns: four gate towers, portcullis frames and bridge collars
parts.acceptance: four gates orient the maze and front gate frames the mission exit

parts.owns: route-to-fortress stairs and elevated internal stair runs
parts.acceptance: stairs visibly explain every major level change

parts.owns: 36 gameplay tile foundations and outer circulation band
parts.acceptance: readable but subordinate; no more than one fifth of fortress-plus-ring apparent area

parts.owns: navigable floor plates, bridges and junction pads
parts.acceptance: continuous player route is legible at 351-pixel width without outlines

parts.owns: recessed branching channels, falls and keep apertures
parts.acceptance: lava is visibly recessed, directional and locally illuminates adjacent masonry

parts.owns: three junction cues and extraction alignment lights
parts.acceptance: choices remain readable without becoming oversized glowing markers

parts.owns: egg crucible tower and nursery terrace
parts.acceptance: distinct open crucible silhouette with contained magma glow

parts.owns: processional flame sanctuary and oath brazier
parts.acceptance: long axial silhouette visibly differs from archive and arena

parts.owns: vaulted library keep and black-glass crown
parts.acceptance: layered vault silhouette and warm slit windows signal an archive

parts.owns: open arena, furnace towers and trial floor
parts.acceptance: clearly open playable arena rather than another closed tower

parts.owns: armoured skiff, heat shields, launch rails and dock socket
parts.acceptance: boat silhouette and launch direction remain obvious at phone scale

parts.owns: navigable molten descent, three steering gates and terminal wake
parts.acceptance: continuous route visibly connects fortress top to the extraction basin

parts.owns: distant hovering spaceship, boarding cradle and approach lights
parts.acceptance: recognizable ship silhouette that does not eclipse the fortress
